plain_language_meaning: A group of isolates with strong genomic similarity that should be checked against nursing-home, ward and timing information.
recommended_wording: Candidate genomic cluster; requires epidemiological confirmation.

plain_language_meaning: Sequence type describes a broad bacterial lineage. The same ST is useful for screening but is not strain-level proof.
recommended_wording: The isolates share ST [number], supporting membership of the same lineage.
avoid_wording: They are the same strain because they have the same ST.

plain_language_meaning: The proportion of detected virulence-factor genes shared by two isolates. 1.00 means identical detected profiles across the 227 genes.
recommended_wording: The isolates had identical/highly similar detected virulence-factor profiles.

plain_language_meaning: A study-wide screening distance from the common core-genome alignment. It is used to shortlist pairs and is not the final pair-specific result.
recommended_wording: The pair passed the preliminary core-SNP screen.
avoid_wording: This screening distance alone confirms the same strain.

plain_language_meaning: Pair-specific whole-assembly comparison. The project uses <=25 SNPs as an operational same-strain threshold.
recommended_wording: The pair was genetically closely related under the project's operational <=25-SNP rule.
avoid_wording: The <=25-SNP result proves who transmitted to whom.

plain_language_meaning: A resistance-associated gene detected in the assembled genome at >=80% identity and >=80% coverage.
recommended_wording: The genome contains [gene], which is associated with [class]; phenotypic susceptibility was not available for confirmation.
avoid_wording: The isolate is clinically resistant to [drug].

plain_language_meaning: Jaccard similarity of detected ResFinder genes after excluding the near-ubiquitous mdf(A) gene from the calculation.
recommended_wording: The isolates shared a similar detected resistance-gene profile.
avoid_wording: The shared AMR profile defines the cluster.

plain_language_meaning: Facility and ward variables are absent from these genomic files. The colleague must link Participant_id to her local metadata.
recommended_wording: Please check whether cluster members overlap by nursing home, ward and time.

plain_language_meaning: No MIC, disk-diffusion or susceptible/intermediate/resistant results were found.
recommended_wording: These are genotypic AMR findings only.
avoid_wording: Genotypic detection is confirmed clinical resistance.

plain_language_meaning: Plasmid replicon screening is not included in this resistance-gene-only report and a shared replicon would not prove an identical plasmid.
recommended_wording: Plasmid structure was not assessed in this report.
avoid_wording: The isolates share the same plasmid.

plain_language_meaning: Different participants, same reliable provider ST, identical 227-gene VF profile, preliminary core SNPs <=25, and direct SNPs <=25.
Different participants, same reliable provider ST, VF Jaccard >=0.95, and preliminary core SNPs <=25; direct validation is pending or supporting information is incomplete.
Different participants with the same ST, VF Jaccard 0.90-0.949, and preliminary core SNPs <=25, or incomplete ST-quality support.
recommended_wording: Possible related lineage; check facility, ward and timing.

plain_language_meaning: 11_compare_strains.R using dnadiff and the project's operational 25-SNP threshold.

recommended_wording: ResFinder gene calls filtered at >=80% identity and coverage.
